mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS scheduleId, w.user_id AS userId, m.name AS scheduleTitle, s.scheduled_at AS scheduledAt FROM schedules s JOIN workations w ON w.id = s.workation_id AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN merchants m ON m.id = s.merchant_id WHERE s.scheduled_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AND s.scheduled_at <= DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
